description: This file defines the interface 'IScreenCapture' for screen capture functionalities within the WPEFramework's Exchange namespace. It includes method declarations for uploading and sending screenshots, as well as notification mechanisms for upload completion events. It is intended to be implemented by classes that provide screen capture and upload features.

classes.name: IScreenCapture
classes.description: Interface for screen capture and upload operations, including registration for notifications and methods to upload or send screenshots.

classes.name: IScreenCapture::Result
classes.description: Structure indicating the success status of a screen capture or upload operation.

classes.name: IScreenCapture::INotification
classes.description: Interface for notifications about screen capture upload completion, providing callback methods.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for screen capture events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: UploadScreenCapture
methods.description: Captures a screenshot, uploads it to the specified URL, and returns success status.

methods.name: SendScreenshot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot and attempts to upload it, returning success status.

methods.name: void UploadComplete(const bool & status,const string & message,const string & call_guid)

ctags.name: INotification
ctags.pattern: /^            struct EXTERNAL INotification : virtual public Core::IUnknown $/

ctags.name: IScreenCapture
ctags.pattern: /^        struct EXTERNAL IScreenCapture : virtual public Core::IUnknown $/

ctags.name: UploadComplete
ctags.pattern: /^                virtual void UploadComplete(const bool& status, const string& message, const str/
ctags.signature: (const bool & status,const string & message,const string & call_guid)
